encoder_method_note:
The message is encoded in the heights of the 24 skyline buildings, read left to right: each building's `height` attribute is 8 times a character value, where letters use their alphabet position (a=1 … z=26) and digits use 30 plus the digit (so 31, 30, 38, 35 → 1, 0, 8, 5). The buildings sit at a regular 30-pixel pitch, and the four empty slots in that grid mark the spaces between words. Everything else (sky, stars, moon, window patterns, reflection) is purely decorative.

  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#070b1f"/>

      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#4a3f6e"/>

    <linearGradient id="fade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">

      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#0b1a33" stop-opacity="1"/>

      <rect x="1.5" y="11" width="2" height="3" fill="#ffd46a" opacity="0.4"/>

    <rect x="515" y="192" width="20" height="248" fill="url(#pb)"/>

    <rect x="695" y="400" width="20" height="40" fill="url(#pa)"/>

</svg>
